timeline.summary: Archaics become erratic and rampage across the plane, and Jadzi seeks the cause.
timeline.quote: Currently, many of the normally gentle archaics have become erratic and incensed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen and Tam arrive at Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, where Jadzi and Fel greet the students.
timeline.quote: Oracle Jadzi was the one who greeted all of us when we arrived at Jawdocks Landing.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam and Lluwen talk for hours with Jadzi until Fel scolds them for wasting the oracle's time.
timeline.quote: We spent a few hours talking, just the three of us

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam tells Lluwen that archaics were once oracles and suggests speaking with Jadzi.
timeline.quote: she told me that all archaics used to be oracles.

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Lluwen overhears Fel and Jadzi argue over Fel's scheme involving students and an oath he swore.
timeline.quote: No, I swore an oath of devotion, Jadzi.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi tells Fel that Professor Vess is missing and that another incident after Kasmina's could cause a stir.
timeline.quote: No one knows where she is,

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel asks Tam and Lluwen if they have seen Oracle Jadzi, who is missing.
timeline.quote: His eyes burning, Fel asked the two of them if they had seen Oracle Jadzi.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Kirol tells Ajani an archaic carried Jadzi away and Fel is acting strangely; Ajani offers a compromise.
timeline.quote: Let me speak with the other professors and see what I can learn.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 2: Travels and Travails" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani tackles Chandra as she prepares to blast the archaic, and Lluwen spots Jadzi in its palm.
timeline.quote: Ajani bowled her over and took them both to the ground.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Chandra hurls her gathered fire over their heads and burns the giant archaic, which screams in pain.
timeline.quote: And before he could stop her, Chandra hurled it over both of their heads.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel says he has been trying to find a way to keep an old promise, and Tam reveals she knows he sought to save the woman he loved, from Jadzi.
timeline.quote: You wanted to try and find some way to go back and save the woman you loved."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Fel says the last he saw of the huge archaic it was carrying Jadzi nearby, and leads the group toward the exit.
timeline.quote: The last we saw of that huge archaic, it was carrying Jadzi not far from here.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 4: Something to Offer" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: They hear the archaic wail and Jadzi's voice from ahead.
timeline.quote: They heard the archaic before they saw it.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: They find Jadzi healing the wounded archaic in the titan's skull, opposite a snarl-like swirl of energy.
timeline.quote: Jadzi kneeled in its palm, still, working a complex healing spell across its flesh.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi, already aware of them, calls out the girl sneaking up on them.
timeline.quote: There's a girl who thinks she can sneak up on us,

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi explains that archaics are oracles flung back in time after death, and that this archaic is the last.
timeline.quote: Archaics are oracles, like I am.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi warns that something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself.
timeline.quote: "Something is threatening the future of Arcavios itself."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi explains the archaics flicker in and out of existence as Arcavios's future is meddled with.
timeline.quote: They've been flickering in and out of existence.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi urges Chandra not to kill the archaic, saying that would treat the symptom and not the disease.
timeline.quote: Snuffing out an archaic is treating the symptom, not the disease.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The archaic wails and a wave of wrongness hits all three, giving Ajani glimpses of another life before it passes.
timeline.quote: The dizziness lingered.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi says the swirl is some kind of nexus at the core of the problem.
timeline.quote: this is at the core of it."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The three of them breathe in time and work to untangle the nexus's threads; Chandra collapses in pain.
timeline.quote: A howl left her as her knees threatened to give out from under her.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 5: Breaking Point" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi tells the students to get to safety while she calms the archaic.
timeline.quote: I need to calm the archaic!"

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam pushes Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.
timeline.quote: She pushed Jadzi into the churning pit of magic.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: In a place that is not quite Strixhaven, Tam stands over the sleeping Jadzi and is comforted by a man in white, who promises she will meet others like her.
timeline.quote: "You've found the others?" she asked him.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 6: Two, Three, Five, Seven" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi, burdened by guilt over not predicting the invasion, now wanders the plane repairing damage.
timeline.quote: She harbors a quiet guilt that she was unable to predict and protect the plane more from the Phyrexian Invasion

citation.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam returns to Hexhaven after kidnapping Jadzi from Strixhaven, feeling empty rather than victorious.
timeline.quote: On paper, she returned from Strixhaven victorious, her mission complete, her captured oracle in hand.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: He reveals that Jadzi must die so he can follow her consciousness back to the origin of a Multiverse.
timeline.quote: "Oh, yes. It's the only way for the phenomenon to be observed.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam visits Jadzi's cell and apologizes, and Jadzi tells her she will find what she is looking for.
timeline.quote: "You'll get what you're looking for."

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: The Theorist goes to Jadzi's cell intending to kill her himself.
timeline.quote: Jadzi, the oracle, awaits with a straight back and a combative glare.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: He dives into Jadzi's mind and drowns in countless possible futures.
timeline.quote: The Theorist's eyes burn bright. He dives into the oracle's mind and crashes into an absolute mess.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi sees his future and the Theorist lowers his hand, failing to kill her.
timeline.quote: The Theorist sees in Jadzi's mind a single image—himself, dropping his hand—and she sees him see it in turn.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.quote: The Theorist turns, embarrassed, furious, and slams the cell door behind him.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 2: Purge Yourself of Doubt" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Sep 2026.

timeline.quote: "It isn't worth it to fight him directly. You need to rescue Jadzi before he can use her."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 5: I Don't Need to Convince You" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam tells Liliana that Jace's body needs to die and asks her to stop him from a distance before he kills Jadzi.
timeline.quote: "I'm asking you to stop him before he can kill Jadzi and make everything worse."

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 7: Pick Up the Pieces" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Vraska reaches the Guildpact in his prison in a ruined chamber; he warns that the Theorist has Jadzi.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.quote: But he cannot muster the courage to kill.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi seizes the knife and cuts her own throat, telling the Theorist to keep his lids open.
timeline.quote: as she cleanly slices the knife across her throat.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 8: Keep Your Lids Open" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2026.

timeline.quote: She's too late. Jadzi must be dead.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Tam finds Kirol, Sanar, Abigale and Lluwen at the Folioplex and apologizes for what happened to Jadzi and to them.
